# DelayPropagationDynamics

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The study of how delays spread through a network of interconnected flights and airports, modeled as a dynamic process on a graph. Understanding propagation dynamics is crucial for TCC/iNEST to design adaptive routing and resource allocation algorithms that respond to cascading failures or congestion in network topologies.
